source_snapshot.items: Dmidecode Information Check in Linux OS
source_snapshot.procedure: Collect SMBIOS Type4 processor and Type7 cache fields and compare with CPU spec.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES commands follow Type4/Type7 but output text wrongly says memory DMI.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Literal CPU/cache collection is read-only and automatable, but Memory identity conflicts.

old_problem: Memory code/subfunction/test-set conflict with an entirely CPU Type4/Type7 procedure and CPU criterion; literal execution would not validate memory.
disposition_reason: The conflict is not a parameter gap or copy word: selecting literal CPU coverage abandons the preserved Memory identity, while replacing it with Type17 invents a different procedure. ED-19 requires retaining each coverage identity, so the source owner must relocate, split or correct the case.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row37 all18 XLSX cells and history2651.
Preserved Memory Source Key/Variant ID and every literal CPU/cache Type4/Type7 field.
Did not silently reinterpret Type4/Type7 as Type17 or delete duplicate CPU relationship; no DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: SMBIOS scope reconciliation for Memory-coded CPU Type4/Type7 validation
test_case.purpose: After scope authority, validate either the preserved literal CPU/cache fields or an explicitly created Memory coverage variant without conflating SMBIOS record types.
required_package: Source-owner decision: retain/relocate literal CPU case, correct to Memory, or split with distinct identities
Approved CPU Type4/Type7 or Memory Type17 specification and exact fields
Secure read-only dmidecode collection and evidence path
Invalid-run and traceability policy for any split/relocation
test_case.test_command: Until scope authority exists, do not claim Memory coverage. Literal diagnostic collection may capture checksum-pinned raw `dmidecode -t processor` and `dmidecode -t cache` only as CPU evidence; a Memory test requires a separately approved Type17 procedure/spec and identity. Preserve raw records and exit status.
test_case.expected_result: The authoritative scope has a matching record type, specification and unique coverage identity, and all named fields match without substituting memory for CPU or CPU for memory.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS is impossible before scope reconciliation. Type4/Type7 proves CPU/cache only; Type17 cannot be introduced under this variant without owner approval.
safety_gate: Use secure access and preserve raw unfiltered SMBIOS records.
Do not rewrite the protected Master or collapse duplicate identities.
No PASS from DeepSeek's incorrect memory-output statement.
expected_evidence: Preserved Source Key and new identity if split
Raw dmidecode records, tool identity and exit status
test_case.recovery: If collection uses the wrong SMBIOS type, preserve the raw files as invalid-scope evidence, remove only temporary output owned by this case, make no firmware or inventory change, and rerun only after the source owner authorizes the correct case identity and record type.

source_conflict.reason: Memory identity and CPU-only Type4/Type7 substance remain mutually incompatible without owner scope authority.

blocked.reason: Source owner can reconcile scope; read-only collection itself is feasible but cannot resolve identity.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: After scope decision, bind the matching CPU or Memory specification and duplicate relationship.
pending.execution_status: ENGINEERING DECISION RETAINED; NO DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.unlock_condition: Approve retain/relocate/correct/split treatment with record-type-matched coverage identities.

project_authority: Only the project source owner can choose which conflicting coverage identity is authoritative.
